Container.Name: Sylo
Container.Overview:
Sylo is a multi-function Discord bot with a web dashboard. It has a per-guild module system (18 modules) - moderation with warning thresholds, server logging, tickets/modmail answered from the dashboard, reaction roles & autoroles, verification (Verify button or Cloudflare Turnstile captcha), welcome/leave messages, sticky messages, auto-moderation (invite/link/flood/mention/caps/word filters), a counting mini-game, custom commands, an autoresponder, scheduled messages, leveling with a public leaderboard, AFK, server statistics (live-count voice channels), a free games notifier (Epic Games Store, plus more stores with an IsThereAnyDeal key), ban appeals (banned members get a DM'd link to an appeal form; staff accept/deny from the dashboard), temporary "join to create" voice channels, and a message/embed creator - plus per-server command management, an editable Discord presence/activity, and Battlefield-series player stats (BF1, BF3, BF4, BFV, Hardline, and best-effort BF2042/BF6) via the public gametools.network API. State is stored in a single SQLite file under /app/data and survives updates.
Setup: create a Discord application at https://discord.com/developers/applications, then set DISCORD_TOKEN (Bot tab) and DISCORD_CLIENT_ID (General Information). Invite the bot with the scopes "bot" and "applications.commands".
Intents: the member/message-driven modules (logging, welcome, roles, verification, leveling, server statistics, auto-moderation, counting, custom commands, autoresponder) need the "Server Members" and/or "Message Content" intents enabled on the Developer Portal Bot page. Leave INTENT_GUILD_MEMBERS / INTENT_MESSAGE_CONTENT at their defaults, or set one to false to boot without that intent (its modules stay unavailable).
Dashboard: runs open by default (use only on a trusted LAN). To require "Log in with Discord" for server admins, set DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET and add http://[UNRAID-IP]:[HOST-PORT]/auth/discord/callback to the app's OAuth2 Redirects.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Sylo dashboard. Only change the host side; the container always listens on 3000.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Where the SQLite database (sylo.db) is stored. Persists across updates/restarts.

Config.Name: DISCORD_TOKEN
Config.Description: Discord bot token (Developer Portal -> your app -> Bot -> Reset Token).

Config.Name: DISCORD_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Discord application (client) ID (Developer Portal -> your app -> General Information).

Config.Name: DISCORD_GUILD_ID
Config.Description: Optional. Set to a server ID to register slash commands to that one guild instantly (useful for testing). Leave blank to register globally (can take up to ~1 hour the first time).

Config.Name: DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Set this (Developer Portal -> OAuth2 -> Client Secret) to require 'Log in with Discord' on the dashboard, restricted to server admins. Also add http://[UNRAID-IP]:[HOST-PORT]/auth/discord/callback to the app's OAuth2 Redirects. Leave blank to run the dashboard open (trusted LAN only).

Config.Name: INTENT_GUILD_MEMBERS
Config.Description: Whether to request the Server Members privileged intent (needed by logging, welcome, roles/autoroles and leveling). Must also be enabled on the Developer Portal Bot page. Set to false to boot without it - those modules then stay unavailable.

Config.Name: INTENT_MESSAGE_CONTENT
Config.Description: Whether to request the Message Content privileged intent (needed by logging, auto-moderation and the counting game). Must also be enabled on the Developer Portal Bot page. Set to false to boot without it - those modules then stay unavailable.

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Any long random string; signs the dashboard session cookie so logins survive a container restart. Auto-generated when blank.

Config.Name: DASHBOARD_URL
Config.Description: Optional. The public dashboard URL (e.g. https://sylo.example.com or http://[UNRAID-IP]:[HOST-PORT]). Needed behind a reverse proxy for the OAuth2 redirect URI, and to build the links members open for verification-captcha and ban appeals. Leave blank for direct IP access without those features.

Config.Name: TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile site key — enables the Verification module's captcha mode. Free at dash.cloudflare.com -> Turnstile. Needs both keys and DASHBOARD_URL set; otherwise captcha mode falls back to a plain Verify button.

Config.Name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile secret key — pairs with TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY for the Verification captcha.

Config.Name: ITAD_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. IsThereAnyDeal API key (free at isthereanydeal.com/apps) — broadens the Free games module beyond the Epic Games Store to Steam, GOG, Fanatical, Humble and more. Without it, Free games is Epic-only.

Config.Name: STATS_CACHE_TTL_MINUTES
Config.Description: How long (minutes) to cache a stats lookup before hitting the API again.

Config.Name: GAMETOOLS_API_BASE
Config.Description: Base URL of the Battlefield stats API.

Config.Name: DATABASE_PATH
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite file inside the container. Must sit inside the Data Directory mount.

Config.Name: WEB_PORT
Config.Description: Port the app listens on inside the container. Leave at 3000 unless you also change the container side of the WebUI Port mapping.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: IANA timezone name, used for timestamps in ticket transcripts and logs. Defaults to Europe/Oslo.
